rule_or_pattern: Drop script_class=latin lines and any label matching (?:[VA]s?w?|V)(?:Rd|Ed|sw),(?:max|min)|\bWu\b (engineering formulas whose subscripts are flattened into the baseline text), plus lines flagged C:cph_out_of_range (crop cut through the text).
notes: Born-digital engineering calculation sheets (Times font) with heavy repetition: 'VRd,max >> VEd,max (ok)' and 'Wu (fortio dokou)' make up 13 of the 18 random lines. Those formula crops print V with subscripts Rd,max / Ed,max / u, while the label puts the subscripts inline, so the label does not describe the glyph layout. Line 25's crop is cut off at mid-height and shows only the top half of the text. The Greek prose and heading lines (3, 5-8, 19-24, 26-34, 36) read correctly; the duplicate pages are covered by the pool-wide dedup rule.
